description: Multiple Character Training in a real EVE client: a Multiple Pilot Training Certificate offers Activate; with no extra queue the dialog shows both queues not active (the second Activate disabled); Activate then Confirm opens queue 2 for 30 days and spends one certificate; Extend adds 30 days to it; the second row opens queue 3. Slots are read from the client's own skill queue service. Needs the client-agent patch; each run needs an account without MCT (change clientLaunch.user to rerun on the same server). Driver: mct/mct.py.
